'''Obatt''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], he tasked a Republic hero to protect a [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] field operative while he dismantled a [[House Ulgo|Ulgo]] sensor in the area. The mission was successful, and the hero returned to Obatt.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Obatt appears in the mission "Special Delivery" for Republic classes in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the mission starting point and endpoint.
